title: Industrial Design Co-op – Summer 2027 (Kinston, NC)
note: Forklift and material-handling ID co-op at Crown's Kinston, NC site for students in a bachelor's Industrial Design program; no visa sponsorship.

facts.duties: User and competitor research including field observation; concept sketches, renderings and models; ergonomic layouts and test bucks; 3D CAD of appearance parts checked with rapid prototypes; help with product graphics, documentation and photography.
facts.requirements: Enrolled in a bachelor's program in Industrial Design; good communication and problem-solving skills; reliable personal transportation; must be authorized to work in the US without sponsorship now or later.
facts.apply: Apply now button on Crown's careers page. A separate posting covers the New Bremen, OH co-op.
